fields.System.Title: INB-4 — Receiving exceptions
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Make the things that went wrong at the dock visible, measurable, and attributable — to
suppliers, and to the warehouse's own process.

Scope

In. Discrepancy records, quality holds, dock-to-stock reporting, supplier performance,
stranded stock alerts.

Out. Supplier claims and chargebacks. The data supports them; the commercial process is
elsewhere.

Design notes

INB-405 is cheap and catches an expensive problem. Stock sitting in a receiving location
over a weekend is stock the system says exists but nobody can sell, because it has no proper
location and no putaway task got picked up. An hourly ageing check finds it in hours instead of
days.

Supplier performance is an aggregate, so it belongs in a read model, not a live query over
every historical receipt.

Blind receipt volume is itself a KPI. High volume means the ASN process upstream is broken,
and no amount of warehouse effort will fix it.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| Stock stranded in receiving | [doc 05 WF 3](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Quarantine stock never dispositioned | [doc 05 WF 2](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Hold not catching already-allocated stock | [doc 09 §8.5](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
